authority: Exactly one source-only intake. No generation, producer/provider/shared-state/Git/build change or child. Root owns coordination/qualification/registration.

nativeObservation.materialInterpretation: Pale wind-packed slightly crusted snow surrounding shallowly proud weathered ochre/brown angular mountain rock. Artistic interpretation, not measured physical or historical proof.
nativeObservation.palette: Cool pale grey-white and blue-grey snowy field; dark ochre/brown exposed rock; no vivid new colour.
nativeObservation.forms: Irregular larger rock groups at upper-left/top and upper-right edges, left/middle groups and larger lower-right group; small isolated tips among broad snowy areas. No grid/joints/bands.
nativeObservation.scale: 128-square source. Most broad exposed-rock clusters span roughly10-45 native pixels, small exposed tips about2-8; subtle material detail remains subordinate.
nativeObservation.contacts: Follow actual original crop through both repeat axes and corners; retain cropped edge rock and snow contacts. No perimeter shelf/blank snow border or invented new isolated stones.

usage.limits: Counts before visibility/entity transformations, not area-weighted; duplicate Portal PAKs collapsed by content. Mixed sloped/vertical/downward use does not identify snow itself or prove playable-ground-only use.

reuse.screenScope: All retained Hexen source-library JSON and image metadata, exact native-size RGBA decodes; see bound receipt.

source.eventualProvider: Existing built-in image tool only after root exact plan approval and journal issue.
source.adequacy: Actual raw at least1024 square; no upscale or independent tier/peer source.
source.subtleDetails: Snow crust/compressed grain and restrained crystalline detail; coherent rock fractures/facets/pits. No all-over noise or sparkling grain.

productionReuseProposalAfterApproval.profileMeaning: Numerical initial filtering only, not semantic snow/rock depth classification.
productionReuseProposalAfterApproval.registration: No preset one-axis landmarks; actual raw must retain distinguishing rock silhouettes/placement. Do not recolour a misplaced boulder into a false landmark.
productionReuseProposalAfterApproval.semanticIntent: Exposed rock bodies sit above adjacent snowy ground; snow has natural shallow texture and partial accumulation at bases. No dark-rock automatic cavities, no bright-snow automatic raised slab, no deep universal rock outline trench.
productionReuseProposalAfterApproval.expectedRisk: Brightness-derived craft may invert pale snow versus dark rock. Initial scalar is explicitly unqualified until actual source/master checks. Do not encode known-wrong tiers.

existingGuardedRepairIfNeeded.prerequisite: Genuine independent source/master replay proof binding actual future source package; native-only proof cannot satisfy guard.
existingGuardedRepairIfNeeded.sourceSpecificGeometry: After raw/master exist, classify actual registered rock bodies/snow contacts. Existing lower substrate polygons represent surrounding snow; proud rocks use complementary upper facing. Coordinates, feather/bevel and positive microAmplitude require actual source measurement/review; none fabricated now.
existingGuardedRepairIfNeeded.preservation: RGB byte-exact; use unchanged full-float photographic craft detail and one finalfloat32 cast. No source/mask noise or new grain.
existingGuardedRepairIfNeeded.limitation: Two ordered planes and shared fine detail may fail irregular rock/snow topology or make plate-like rocks. If convincing natural facets and snow relief cannot survive this existing policy, HOLD and report the specific incompatibility; no new producer or sparse featureless substitute.

beforeTiers: Actual adequate source recognizable as snow/rock at1:1, no synthetic grain.
Check source-registered rock silhouettes/placement and both-axis/corner contacts against native.
Independent visible rock body, nearby snow, partial cover and mixed-interface physical sample classifications.
Float height and fixed opposed lights show intended shallow rock/snow hierarchy and natural detail, no perimeter bevel.
Use guarded repair only after true source/master proof and actual source-specific plan if ordinary scalar is wrong.

verificationAfterApproval: Public authoring HTML/review; source/tool/math/codec replay of master and all10maps, descriptor/HTML/content-label provenance.
Native and decoded colour both BOX64 and BOX32, preserving composition/style/local palette/feature scale from distance.
Actual decoded Mid512/High1024 diffuse/height/XYZ, fixed neutral opposed lights; literal1:1 X/Y joins, all corners and2x2 repeats.
No clipping-driven relief masks, deep dark-rock cavities, snow-raised slab, perimeter bevel or coherent tiling rail.
Root independent final source/ART/technical qualification separate from author self-check.
stop: Generation count0/not-issued; no generated/master/tier directory. Root independent exact plan review is next.
